title: The Lake Answers Twice: Threshold Sign
description: The Lake Answers Twice unfolds across mirror lake sanctum with moon bridges and black-water reflection hazards, pushing a 5-Titan Kami Titan to prove precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Lake Answers Twice: Threshold Sign advances Kami Mirror Tempest: The Sacred Kingdoms test whether the Creator can cleanse Gate reflections without breaking shrine law or spirit contracts. It directly tests the faction tension: Their secrecy protects sacred balance but makes allies fear what they cannot see.
